voice.prosody: In 1958, inside a guarded office in Chicago, a small group of scientists were given a secret assignment. It had no public name. Just a number. A one-one-nine. The United States was losing the space race, and the military wanted something the whole world would see. Something so bright, it could be watched from every city on Earth. Their plan was to detonate a nuclear bomb on the Moon. For more than forty years, almost no one knew it had ever existed.
